scope: Independent scientific description, semantic atomicity and whole selected-source-duty review of the exact three frozen v3 candidate payloads. No active integration, dependency approval, current D/P/A/M/V closure or human review is claimed.
basis: Own actual full-page text/raster reading of independently fetched official originals, own DEEN target and partner-context inspection, and own exact-CAS reconstruction.

exactDEENCompetence.title: Entsorgung und Recycling von Batterien und Akkumulatoren bewerten
exactDEENCompetence.titleEn: Assess disposal and recycling of batteries and accumulators
exactDEENCompetence.description: Die lernende Person kann Entsorgung und Recycling von Batterien und Akkumulatoren an geeigneten Beispielen fachlich diskutieren und anhand der Umweltfolgen begründet bewerten.
exactDEENCompetence.descriptionEn: The learner can discuss disposal and recycling of batteries and accumulators using suitable examples and assess them with reasons based on their environmental consequences.

goalFindings.ownFinding: This is one environmental decision about the end-of-use stage of electrochemical sources. Disposal and recovery are options or connected stages within that decision; non-rechargeable and rechargeable examples are transfer cases of the same competence. The text requires actual reasons from environmental consequences rather than a bare sorting instruction or an unexamined opinion. Both languages retain discussion, assessment, batteries and accumulators.
goalFindings.semanticAtomicityReason: One contextual assessment routine is applied across battery examples. It does not add the independent skills of constructing a cell, formulating electrode reactions, ranking all battery chemistries or explaining an industrial recycling mechanism.
goalFindings.assessabilityObservation: A bounded material-based case may supply composition, disposal/recovery options and impacts for a primary cell and an accumulator, then require a reasoned discussion and judgment. Testing only correct-bin selection, or only primary-cell functioning, would leave the goal unassessed.
sourceCoverageLimits: The HH assessment verb is an operationalization supported by page context, not the wording of the selected nominal bullet.
The MV individual component remains partial because this goal alone omits the separate rare-metal extraction discussion.
Only HH/MV SekII scope is proposed; no national visibility grant.

exactDEENCompetence.title: Gewinnung seltener Metalle für Spannungsquellen diskutieren
exactDEENCompetence.titleEn: Discuss extraction of rare metals for electrochemical sources
exactDEENCompetence.description: Die lernende Person kann die Rohstoffgewinnung seltener Metalle für elektrochemische Spannungsquellen an geeigneten Beispielen fachlich diskutieren.
exactDEENCompetence.descriptionEn: The learner can discuss extraction of rare metals for electrochemical sources using suitable examples and scientific reasoning.

goalFindings.ownFinding: The assessable object is the extraction of selected rare metals used for electrochemical sources. The retained qualifier prevents a generic raw-material discussion from standing in for this duty. Discussion requires a supported account with alternatives or consequences appropriate to supplied information; it does not require reconstructing mining or metallurgical reaction mechanisms.
goalFindings.semanticAtomicityReason: One scientifically grounded discussion of a specified extraction context. Environmental disposal judgments have been placed in the other goal instead of silently bundling the entire source sentence into this atom.
goalFindings.assessabilityObservation: A selected rare-metal extraction case with adequate information can elicit a connected scientific discussion. Merely naming a metal, treating all metals as rare, or replacing rare metals with rare-earth elements does not establish the competence.
sourceCoverageLimits: Only MV SekII duty is proposed.
No compulsory named metal, exhaustive rare-metal taxonomy or industrial reaction derivation follows from this cell.
The exact MV original must accompany the compressed extraction paraphrase, whose title alone loses the rare-metal qualifier.

exactDEENCompetence.title: Metallrecycling für Konsum- und Entsorgungsentscheidungen nutzen
exactDEENCompetence.titleEn: Use metal recycling knowledge for consumption and disposal decisions
exactDEENCompetence.description: Die lernende Person kann die Bedeutung des Metallrecyclings für Ressourcenschonung und Energieeinsparung beschreiben und auf dieser Grundlage das eigene Konsum- und Entsorgungsverhalten begründet bewerten.
exactDEENCompetence.descriptionEn: The learner can describe the significance of metal recycling for conserving resources and saving energy and use that account to assess their own consumption and disposal choices with reasons.

goalFindings.ownFinding: The text preserves the precise link from metal-recycling knowledge to an informed personal choice. Resource conservation and energy saving are both named in German and English, and both consumption and disposal are assessed. The goal cannot be passed with a generic sustainability opinion or with an explanation of recycling machinery alone.
goalFindings.semanticAtomicityReason: The description supplies the explicit evidential basis of a single judgment routine. Removing the description would weaken the normative duty; splitting it solely at the conjunction would sever the intended knowledge-to-decision relation.
goalFindings.assessabilityObservation: A qualitative comparison with a stated system boundary can support a learner-chosen hypothetical consumption/disposal example. The response must connect the resource and energy accounts to its reasons; an automatic always-recycle verdict or a zero-energy claim is insufficient.
sourceCoverageLimits: Only NW first-stage SekI duty is proposed.
No machinery, detailed process mechanism or quantitative LCA duty is added.
A hypothetical example can assess the competence without recording private learner or household data.

wholeSelectedSourceCellFindings.ownCompletenessFinding: The explicit battery-and-accumulator disposal/recycling goal now supplies the end-of-use duty that the old primary-cell advantages/disadvantages goal did not require. The partial old edge may coexist without carrying the missing duty. The new operationalization is broader than the literal content heading, so an exact HH edge is not claimed.

coversSelectedDuty: Discussion of electrochemical-source disposal environmental problems
Discussion of extraction of rare metals for electrochemical sources

wholeSelectedSourceCellFindings.ownCompletenessFinding: Two atoms cover the full discussion sentence together. The first supplies disposal/recycling; the second supplies the rare-metal extraction object. Neither charging/discharging reactions nor a primary-only restriction is imported from neighbouring text. Retaining only one new component would reopen the full-source gap.

coversSelectedDuty: Describe resource-conservation significance of metal recycling
Describe energy-saving significance of metal recycling
Use that basis for a reasoned personal consumption/disposal assessment

wholeSelectedSourceCellFindings.ownCompletenessFinding: The dedicated personal-decision goal states all content and operator requirements of this bullet. The broad generic decision target retains only a partial methodological connection and cannot be relabelled exact. The page-24 locator remains necessary; the completeness judgment applies to this one assessment bullet, not all metal-production duties.

partnerContextFinding: The 22 coupled goals retain exact current/frozen competence texts. Plastics, polymer mechanisms, cell/electrolysis routines, LCA, metal modelling, careers and source/authorship routines do not become new duties of these three selected recycling cells. The retained primary-cell and generic decision targets still contribute only their limited assessment parts. Broad inherited paths and routing words cannot establish full duty coverage.
routedAlternativesLimit: The 26 supplied routing hits were read as bilingual alternatives, not treated as a full manual review of every goal in either 523-node canonical input.
